content: For the treatment of heart failure in pediatric patients: Loading Dose: For children aged 5 to 10 years: Administer a loading dose of 20 to 45 mcg/kg. Initially, give half of the total loading dose, followed by one-quarter of the loading dose every 6 to 8 hours for two additional doses. For children aged 10 years and older: Administer a loading dose of 10 to 15 mcg/kg. Initially, give half of the total loading dose, followed by one-quarter of the loading dose every 6 to 8 hours for two additional doses. Maintenance Dose: For children aged 2 to 5 years: Administer 10 to 15 mcg/kg/day. For children aged 5 to 10 years: Administer 7 to 10 mcg/kg/day. For children older than 10 years: Administer 3 to 5 mcg/kg/day. For off-label pediatric use: Supraventricular Tachycardia, Recurrent (Prophylaxis): Administer 0.01 mg/kg orally three times daily for the first two doses. Then, reduce the dose to 0.0035 mg/kg orally three times daily. Fetal Tachycardia Supraventricular Tachycardia: For maternal treatment, administer 0.25 to 0.375 mg orally once daily, either alone or in combination with verapamil.
